subject.title: feat: add Computer Use plugin manifest contract

question: Should OpenClaw accept `contracts.computerUseProviders` and `computerUseProviderMetadata` as a public metadata-only plugin manifest contract for macOS Computer Use discovery with these field names and permission semantics?
rationale: The patch is additive, but once released these fields become plugin-author API surface and are intended to guide host behavior around Accessibility and Screen Recording permissions.

options.title: Accept after docs and owner confirmation
options.body: Regenerate the docs map, rerun docs checks, and confirm that host code treats the metadata as discovery-only before merge.

options.title: Revise the contract shape first
options.body: Rename or narrow the fields, platform shape, permission enum, or MCP metadata before freezing the public plugin contract.

options.title: Pause for host design alignment
options.body: Keep the PR draft until macOS host discovery and permission binding semantics are settled enough to publish.

recommendation.title: Accept after docs and owner confirmation
recommendation.body: Regenerate the docs map, rerun docs checks, and confirm that host code treats the metadata as discovery-only before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history-backed ownership signal for plugin manifest metadata and docs surfaces, and is the best available routing candidate for this API/security-boundary choice.
